reasons.persona_fit: Directly speaks to small business owner-operators in Bareni's calm, practical tone without hype. Complies fully with the no-CTA brief.
reasons.clarity: The core thesis is immediately clear and logically developed from extraction limits to post-extraction workflow rules.
reasons.actionability: Provides clear criteria for evaluating automation viability and a concrete, self-diagnostic next step to map rules and time cost.
reasons.factual_grounding: Accurately represents demonstrated system boundaries, including mandatory human approval before moving money and the absence of three-way matching.
